newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's Industrial Bank lends $51.5mln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's Industrial Bank lends $51.5mln in 1996.

text.p: Loans extended by the Industrial Bank of Kuwait to finance projects amounted to 15.6 million dinars ($51.5 million) in 1996, a 76 percent rise compared to 1995, the official Kuwait News Agency reported on Monday.
It said the loans extended in 1996 covered for 44 percent of the full cost of a total of 15 industrial projects.

The Kuwait Investment Authority, the state investment arm, owns 32 percent of the bank which acts as a conduit for soft government loans to industry projects. Other state bodies are also shareholders in the bank.
